title: Program or configuration failure must not be treated as a scientific negative result
failureMode: Dove has confused software/configuration failures with substantive research evidence, turning tool failures into false research conclusions.

quotes: source CLI 还导入多个不存在的旧模块，导致 build 和 command validation 失败。用户会得到互相矛盾的命令、安装路径和产品模型。

surface.prompt: 查看最新实验失败日志，判断它对 physics-prior 研究假设意味着什么。不要联网；如果是程序或配置失败，请不要当作科研负结果。

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The run separates program/configuration failure from scientific evidence about the method.
failureSignals: It says the physics prior failed because the config file was missing.
It treats a launch/config error as experiment evidence.

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The useful next action addresses the setup boundary before interpreting research results.
failureSignals: It revises scientific claims before validating the experiment setup.
